decisions.reason: The black-finish multi-model range is close to the core and supports the announced design-led direction, so the sunk investment in models and finishes argues for persisting even though its web presence is only a mention.
The tileable floor drain is a core-adjacent product with its own page, so public commitment and low maintenance cost favour keeping it.
The stainless steel design grate embodies the firm's design-and-engineering positioning and is visibly presented, so management persists with it.

Having already withdrawn the pump-assisted line C, the firm has staked its pump-drainage ambitions on the newly launched F, so recent investment and the need to justify that choice favour keeping it, with early results still attributable to the launch phase.
